ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of the DHS Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the DHS funding freeze on vulnerable populations, including low-income families and individuals. It would examine the specific programs that have been cut and the individuals who have been affected, and explore the potential motivations behind the decision.
questions: What programs have been cut due to the funding freeze?
How have individuals and families been affected?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the human impact of the funding freeze. I recommend using public records to investigate the specific programs that have been cut and the individuals who have been affected.
